description: Prerelease tracking for NuGet packages that Dependabot cannot follow (Dependabot has no documented opt-in for prereleases). Renovate only touches the packages listed below; everything else stays with Dependabot. Inert until the Renovate GitHub App is installed on the repository.

packageRules.description: Default: Renovate does not touch NuGet packages. Dependabot owns them.
Tracked: follow prereleases as well as stable releases (see docs/FORWARD-FACING.md).

Skip prerelease MAJOR bumps (for example StackExchange.Redis 4.0.x alpha, PR 596) until a stable release exists. Stable majors and prerelease minor/patch updates still flow. .NET runtime-aligned packages (Microsoft.*, Npgsql 11 previews) keep intentional prerelease tracking.
xunit.v3 4.x is binary-incompatible with Avalonia.Headless.XUnit 12.1.x (see Directory.Packages.props).
